decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already records automatic background wallet creation and minting directly to the newly created wallet, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Automatically minting after fiat conversion does not change the mint price, founder allocation, commission allocation, or prize-pool funding.
The automatic Transak mint flow does not change the optional tip controls or permitted tip amounts.
Message 184 requests the fiat-buyer explanation as FAQ content and does not require the About page to describe automatic Transak minting.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already states in the FAQ purchase flow that Transak converts fiat to crypto and mints to the newly created wallet without manual configuration.
Automatic minting after fiat conversion does not alter the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode.
The source decision does not change how a commission is allocated when no referral code is entered.
Automatic minting after conversion does not change SIWE authentication; the separate message-184 dashboard sign-in update is already represented.
The fiat mint execution sequence does not change the Small Block prize amount, cadence, eligibility, funding, or qualifying sale types.
Automatic NFT minting after fiat conversion does not itself change prize payout behavior; the distinct direct-wallet payout decision from message 184 is already represented.
The source decision changes when the NFT is minted, not which counters, badges, or referral-code attributes its metadata must expose.
Automatic fiat minting does not change Big Block ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility, reset behavior, or wallet-holding requirements.
